data.narrative:
Drafter is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chris Barton and Peter Atkin that has raised $3M+. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 private robotics companies and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), though narrow peer comparables at identical stage and valuation tier remain limited.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable lens. Using the $3M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields $7.5M. Peer-median triangulation is not supportable here: while the robotics and manufacturing sector contains 10 peers, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier valuations does not yield the minimum three datapoints required for reliable median estimation. Attempting to force an all-sector median would conflate meaningfully different risk and growth profiles.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, centered on $8M. This range reflects the stage-progression methodology with conservative and optimistic variance around the 2.5x multiplier. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at Seed stage in this subsector, which limits cross-validation of the step-up multiple and leaves the valuation sensitive to assumptions about post-Seed growth trajectory and capital efficiency relative to broader robotics benchmarks.
